en.bdb: Lamps are lighted in the night of divali festival;
Stars of different variety appear in the sky;

verses.gurmukhi: ਫੁਲਾਂ ਦੀ ਬਾਗਾਤਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਚਾਲੀਅਨਿ।
verses.translit_en: fulaa(n) dhee baagaat chun chun chaaleean|

en.bdb: In the gardens the flowers are there which are selectively plucked;
The pilgrims going to pilgrimage centres are also seen.
The imaginary habitats have been seen coming into being and vanishing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੀਅਨਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal dhaat sabadh samhaaleean ||6||

en.bdb: All these are momentary, but the gurmukhs with the help of the Word nourish the gift of the pleasure fruit.
